metrics.name: onset_repetitions
metrics.threshold: extra fragment(s) before the word, +time at this boundary

metrics.name: fragment_vs_word_onset_similarity
metrics.threshold: MFCC cosine > 0.80 = the same onset repeated

regions.explanation: At 21.15s, the onset of “change.” is repeated 2 time(s) before the word is completed (fragment-to-onset spectral similarity 0.93). Repeated onsets before the word is completed fragment it and interrupt the speech rhythm. Fix: Begin the word once, deliberately; a short breath before it helps.

metrics.name: pause_length
metrics.threshold: >= 0.3 s longer than reference, mid-phrase (no punctuation)

regions.explanation: At 70.94s, between “but” and “from”, a 1.33 s silence replaced the reference's 0 ms pause. A long silence where the reference has none - especially mid-phrase - breaks the syntactic unit and signals lost place rather than deliberate emphasis. Fix: Keep this phrase in one breath; pause at the punctuation instead.
